- compose-action v3.2.0: The release cadence and focus on this workflow component matter for SREs and platform engineers because it directly impacts CI execution consistency (service startup sequencing and compose invocation behavior) for teams adopting HoverKraft projects.

## Release Summary

Compose logs are now streamed during post-job cleanup, improving visibility into service shutdown and troubleshooting.

Internal updates include refreshed documentation, developer-experience improvements, and dependency/tooling upgrades across GitHub Actions, devcontainers, and npm development dependencies.
